unification.c1: Here you can set the mode the unification will work in, options: 'full': uses the exact json base files without changes, 'replace': replaces instead of adds, when remove is available, 'no_add': doesn't add new items only replaces and removes originals, uses the same logic as 'replace'
unification.c2: This is a list of mod priorities used if mode is replace or no_add, uses alphabatical order if not provided
unification.c3: Here you can overwrite the mod chosen for a specific material, syntax: {material: mod}
unification.c4: Here you can enable or disable weither gems textures should be replaced

ores.c1: What should the metal drop, options: raw, ore
ores.c2: Weither the metal should be affected by silk touch
ores.c3: Weither the metal should be affected by fortune
ores.c4: What should the gem drop, options: gem, ore
ores.c5: Weither the gem should be affected by silk touch
ores.c6: Weither the gem should be affected by fortune
ores.c7: Here you can modify the ore drop dimension multiplier for the ores
